headline: Ravens' Zay Flowers downgraded to out because of hamstring injury
summary: The Baltimore Ravens downgraded Pro Bowl wide receiver Zay Flowers to out for Sunday's game against the New Orleans Saints.

headline: Steelers rule out WR Pittman Jr. vs. Patriots with foot injury
summary: The Steelers will be without another starter for their Week 2 game against the Patriots after downgrading wide receiver Michael Pittman Jr. to out with a foot injury.

headline: Bengals elevate Josh Johnson to active roster with Joe Burrow questionable
summary: Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow says he plans to play tomorrow against the Texans.
